caseName: Hess v. Port Authority Trans-Hudson Corporation
caseNameFull: Hess Et Al. v. Port Authority Trans-Hudson Corporation

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: ‘Whether Port Authority Trans-Hudson Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of a bistate agency created by interstate compact, is entitled to sovereign immunity from suit in federal court under the Eleventh Amendment?”
